reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the preferred playbook position is 'No non-solicit on Customer'; the absence of any solicitation/no-hire covenant in the Agreement satisfies that position, so retaining this as internal evidence is correct.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered text is identical to the original (no unintended edits).
The § 14.10 entire-agreement clause is a defensible anchor for an absence finding, since it delimits the documents in scope (and flags the incorporated NDA/SOW as places a non-solicit could reside).

The failed deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable heuristics where no non-solicit clause exists, and the rationale correctly explains this rather than fabricating compliance language.
